candidates.decision_relevance: Would let the reviews distinguish intraperiod selloffs, rebounds and relative-strength changes from endpoint summaries, and assess whether deterioration preceded or followed price weakness.
candidates.evidence_reference: Repeated weekly and daily reviews note missing numerical price paths or time ordering; some daily outputs provide sampled hourly ETH/BTC observations but not a comparable BTC, ETH and ETH/BTC history across the reviewed episodes.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped hourly BTC, ETH and ETH/BTC price series
candidates.missing_history_problem: Without continuous, cutoff-aligned paths, the analyses cannot test path ordering, recovery magnitude or whether signals led the drawdowns.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether participation weakness or recovery persisted across the reported episodes rather than appearing in isolated proxy snapshots.
candidates.evidence_reference: Reviews repeatedly cite proxy breadth snapshots with changing membership, differing capture times and unconfirmed comparability; W44 explicitly lacks a breadth series.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped advancer/decliner breadth observations with universe and membership identifiers
candidates.missing_history_problem: Snapshot differences cannot establish a persistent participation trend when universes and timestamps differ.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would establish whether the mixed or negative BTC and ETH settled-flow observations persisted, diverged or reversed during the reviewed weeks.
candidates.evidence_reference: Multiple reviews state that only the latest settled session or prior-week rows are supplied, and explicitly caution against treating W43 flows as W44 evidence.
candidates.metric_name: Daily settled BTC and ETH ETF flow totals with session dates
candidates.missing_history_problem: Sparse session coverage prevents testing flow persistence and aligning flows with price and participation sequences.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would make historical forecast comparisons auditable for ex-ante timing, target precision, range containment and horizon-matched outcomes without using later information at earlier freezes.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews repeatedly report omitted candidate definitions, bounds, issue times and per-candidate matured outcomes; daily reviews describe candidate objects as unratified and not empirically calibrated.
candidates.metric_name: Frozen forecast candidate records joined to horizon-matched realized metric paths and outcomes
candidates.missing_history_problem: Candidate counts or broad summaries cannot reveal whether forecasts were falsifiable, issued before the evaluated path, or accurate beyond broad-range containment.
